label: Network Traffic Pro
summary: Advanced traffic and overlay-network orchestration with reviewed routing policies, measured checks and staged changes across qualified edge providers. Specific load-balancer, DNS, CDN and tunnel integrations remain separate connectors.
core_boundary: Core retains baseline IP/network/firewall administration, management-access recovery and the seven essential engine adapters. This module adds optional global/overlay coordination; it cannot supply arbitrary network scans, tunnels or firewall command strings.
acceptance: Map public/private listeners, routing authority, certificates and allowed upstreams before accepting a traffic plan.
Qualify protocol, source-address, timeout and health semantics for each selected provider combination.
Test management lockout prevention, failed configuration checks, lost connectivity and supported rollback.
Constrain probe and tunnel destinations, rate limits and credentials; reject metadata/control-plane reachability.
Disable new automation without removing current routing or the Core's independent network recovery route.
